title: Singapore hit-and-run: organiser of fund for orphaned boy vows transparency
text:
Singapore hit-and-run: organiser of fund for orphaned boy vows transparency | South China Morning Post People - People Singapore hit-and-run: organiser of fund for orphaned boy vows transparency 1 Advertisement Singapore This Week in Asia People Singapore hit-and-run: organiser of fund for orphaned boy vows transparency 
 Some online questioned the legitimacy of the campaign to help the orphan after his parents died in the alleged hit-and-run accident
 2 -MIN READ 2 -MIN 1 Listen SCMP’s Asia desk Published: 4:50pm, 3 Nov 2026 An organiser behind a fundraiser for a boy whose parents died in an alleged hit-and-run accident in Singapore has vowed transparency, thanking donors for their “overwhelming” kindness amid debate over the campaign’s authenticity. Farah Diyanah Razid, who identified herself as a family member of the victims on the crowdfunding platform Give.Asia, said all contributions collected through the drive were intended solely for the child’s welfare and future.
 The clarification came after social media users cast doubt on her initial online donation appeal featuring an e-payment QR code. It followed last week’s crash that left the couple, both aged 24, dead.
